Penn State (4-4, 1-4 Big Ten) makes its longest road trip of the season in Week 10 with a road game at Washington (5-3, 2-3 Big Ten) for the first Big Ten meeting between the two schools on Washington's home field. Penn State won the last meeting with the Huskies two seasons ago in the initial Big Ten meeting between the two programs, and Penn State leads the all-time series with a clean 4-0 record. But improving that mark to 5-0 will be a challenge for a Penn State squad looking for back-to-back wins for the first time since September.
 Get real-time updates, scoring plays, turning points, and expert analysis throughout Penn State's game against Washington. Follow along for highlights, injury news, key plays, and instant breakdown as the Nittany Lions take on Huskies in a pivotal Big Ten showdown.
